name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyValueToChildren
summary: Walks two child containers and writes the same value into each child's +0x70 field; the loop shape is clear but the owner class and field meaning are not established.
evidence: Only caller is Ui_Dive_ReloadTextResources; entry is 2-mod-4 mid-function block; no named callees or strings.

name: maybe_Container_AddToFirstFreeSlot
signature: void* maybe_Container_AddToFirstFreeSlot(Container* c, u8 kind, u32 forwarded, u32 second)
summary: Finds the first free of five 9-word slots, stores the kind byte at +0x18, configures the slot via vtable +0xC and splices it into the list at +0xC0.
evidence: Five-way slot search with global null handle and list splice are verified; caller is maybe_Container_AddInstanceWithHandle; splice helper resolves into misnamed Snd_DetachChannel.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipRow_RangeCheck
summary: Compares the row cursor with the list end marker; the decompiler lost the real body after the comparison, so the operation is unreadable.
evidence: Body is halt_baddata plus bogus func_0xff7e4072; only `if (*f_C4 != f_C0)` is certain; Ui_EquipRow family confirmed by named siblings.

name: maybe_Container_UnlinkAndReleaseHandles
summary: Intended to empty a handle list by resolving, unlinking and releasing each entry, but the recovered C is a single garbage expression.
evidence: Recovered body is `in_r12 + unaff_r4*0x1000000`; four callees resolve into unrelated named functions, i.e. inner entries.

name: maybe_Gfx_Node_DrawWithParentTransform
signature: void maybe_Gfx_Node_DrawWithParentTransform(GfxNode* self, float forwarded, float b, int c)
summary: Vtable slot that calls slot +0x7C on itself and forwards the result to slot +0x70; sits next to Gfx_Node_ApplyTransformMatrix in the Field_SceneObject table, so a transform-related forwarder is likely.
evidence: Row 0x007616B4 in Field_SceneObject table, previous slot 0x005F6E34, next confident Gfx_Node_ApplyTransformMatrix 0x005F6AA0; neither slot's meaning proven.

name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_NotifyAttachedObjects
summary: Runs the scene-node teardown entry and notifies the two attached objects selected by index bytes at +0x339/+0x33A, calling child slot +0xC or +8 depending on flags.
evidence: Calls Field_Object_DtorBase; row 0x007617C0 is tail of Field_SceneObject-derived table; body ends in indirect tail calls, no value returned.

name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_NotifyChildrenState
summary: Notifies the two child objects referenced by slot bytes +0x339/+0x33A: calls child slot +8 when active and both flags set, otherwise slot +0xC to cancel.
evidence: Body readable and unchanged; caller Field_CreateActorFromId (0x001C7370) named, supporting field-NPC action class; child class and flags unnamed.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_SetFlagsOnTwoObjects
summary: Thumb fragment inside a larger function rather than a standalone routine; the exported address is mid-function and the body is a single halt_baddata().
evidence: Mid-function export, r4/r5 come from caller, body is halt_baddata; only callee is Gfx_ModelPart_SetAttributeMask.

name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_DeletingDtor
summary: Deleting destructor: calls the shared Actor2D deleting destructor 0x0028EFA4 and frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.
evidence: Only callee is Actor2D_EffectNode_DeletingDtor (0x0028EFA4) plus the free helper; concrete class not proven, vtable row 0x00761A68 only adjacent to the ctor table.

name: maybe_Gfx_MeshNode_DeletingDtor
summary: Deleting destructor: runs the base node deleting destructor 0x002B6260 and frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.
evidence: Single named callee Gfx_Node_DeletingDtor (0x002B6260) plus free; class identity only inferred from vtable neighbours.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyTextEvent
summary: Shared window event handler: on event kind 1 marks the window open, binds the u16 text id at event+2 and forwards event+4/+8/+9 to the embedded window; otherwise marks closed and tail-calls the base handler.
evidence: Four named UI text callers (Ui_PokerWindow_BindCardText, Ui_MainMenuText_SetWindowState, equip menu, item icon) use it as a shared window event applier; body is damaged decompilation (bad instruction data, unaff registers).

name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_ChildWindow_DeletingDtor
summary: Deleting destructor of the window embedded at parent+0x138: stores the vtable, tears down the child object chain and frees the block.
evidence: Both callers are Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Dtor and Ui_ItemInfoWindow_DtorDelete; asm stores vtable at r0 with +0x138 offset recovery, matching an embedded child window dtor.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_DeletingDtor
summary: Deleting destructor of a small field actor-action/scene object: runs the shared Gfx object-desc base destructor 0x00193E44 and frees the storage.
evidence: Only callee is Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init/base dtor 0x00193E44 plus free; vtable 0x007625D8 is a distinct non-collision class but 'gimmick' remains a guess.

name: maybe_Field_ActionList_FillSlotsWithTimers
summary: Fills the field action list with timer action rows: allocates 0x2C-byte rows, builds each and inserts it via Container_SlotReplace.
evidence: Callees include Battle_ActionAnimEntry_Create, Field_HorseAction_Ctor_vt7625D4, Actor_ActionList_SortByPriority and the split-symbol continuation 0x002FB790; body is halt_baddata due to Thumb/ARM mode error, so the timer wording is inferred.

name: maybe_Field_ActionList_FillSlotsWithHorseActions
summary: Continuation of the field action-list fill loop: allocates 0x2C/0x34/0x48-byte horse-action objects via the Field_HorseAction constructors and installs them with Container_SlotReplace.
evidence: Mid-function split symbol inside 0x002FB710's unrolled loop; callees are Field_HorseAction_Ctor, its variant, Field_ActorTurnAction_Ctor and Container_SlotReplace; body is halt_baddata.

name: maybe_Text_Block_BindSourceList
summary: Moves the source list at source+0xD8 into the block, notifies the owner through virtual +0x5C and activates the sub-widget at self+0xCF9.
evidence: No callers; only named callee Snd_DetachChannel (0x00123564) is a generic move helper; the bind+activate shape is confirmed by 0x002FE24C but the text-block class is inferred.

name: maybe_Text_Block_CloseAndActivate
summary: Notifies the owner via virtual +0x5C with the area at self+0xF42, then sets the sub-widget at self+0xCF9 active; the 'close' half is still an interpretation.
evidence: Body only calls the vtable slot +0x5C with &self->f_f42 and then func_0029126C(&self->f_cf9,1); no core state or text id is written, and the class is only known to be a text block.
